source_reviews.name: card_ral_storm_conduit

source_reviews.name: card_volcanic_wind

source_reviews.name: ai_assign_blockers
source_reviews.reason: Make the native first-pass assignment-table snapshot explicit before get_card_instance, rather than relying on assignment operand evaluation order. Assembly 026abdd8..026abdf7 saves the value in edi across the getter. Live table bounds, second-pass snapshots, triggers and UI callbacks are unchanged.

source_reviews.name: war_god_eternal
source_reviews.reason: Restore inst/kc/owner/position/iid and explicit grave/exile branches. The unsigned kill-code snapshot precedes callbacks; grave IID is read after chooser, exile IID before ownership query, and only exact chooser zero accepts.

source_reviews.name: card_pledge_of_loyalty
source_reviews.reason: Restore keyword/p/c/clr/i scopes and two descending starting-count scans. Capture the first player after humiliation, re-read the second player after first-pass callbacks, preserve attachment field reads after humiliation, self-controller gate before type queries and the color snapshot. No APNAP macro or live reverse bound substitution.

source_reviews.name: card_scion_of_draco
source_reviews.reason: Restore clr and the ordered five independent color grants. Keep signed-byte domain reduction, saved color across sleight/ability callbacks and fresh affected globals at every use; no added humiliation guard for cost.

source_reviews.name: card_azors_elocutors
source_reviews.reason: Separate damage, instance and counters scopes instead of overlaying all results. Keep adding counters during AI evaluation, fresh counter query after potential lose callback, fresh getter after damage classification and distinct trigger getter/reset.

source_reviews.name: rfg_card_from_grave
source_reviews.reason: Restore native num_cards/num_spells/num_creatures/iid/c roles and a live forward scan. Preserve raw type masks in packed event result, unsigned 500 capacity guard, re-read grave source and pointer after dispatch, retain returned IID across scan callbacks, and do not add an empty-slot guard.

source_reviews.name: card_ensouled_scimitar

Native 0202d26c calls artifact_animation, 0202d271 moves saved incoming player (esi) to the first argument, then 0202d278 calls get_card_instance and writes Spirit. Preserve live mode re-read after equipment resolution.

strict_cfg_after.scope: Strict entry-reachable CFG comparison with exact unique COFF symbol identities and unchanged engine addresses and complete read-only C-string/DIALOG-token contents. Matched callees and globals remain identity/behavior assumptions; padding and direct jump trampolines are ignored. No whole-game or arbitrary callee equivalence claim.

compiled_verification.scope: One build after the complete source batch, then 35 focused checks with the unchanged strict comparator. Eight match; 26 retain instruction differences and one has no unique full current COFF entry. No forced registers/stack allocation, gameplay proof or full reccmp refresh. C710 full-report scores remain historical C709 build results.

reviewed_corrections.name: card_ensouled_scimitar
reviewed_corrections.detail: The incoming player value, not the parent controller field, owns the post-animation legacy lookup. Native 0202d26c artifact_animation -> 0202d271 mov [esp],esi -> 0202d278 get_card_instance -> Spirit write. Prologue 0202d199 loads esi from incoming player. The corrected complete function now matches the native strict CFG (197 states).

reviewed_corrections.name: ai_assign_blockers
reviewed_corrections.detail: First assignment value is explicitly saved before the getter. Native 026abdde loads assignment into edi; 026abdf0 calls get_card_instance; 026abdf5/7 store its saved low byte. This makes required order explicit in source; it is not evidence that the previous GCC build misordered the expression. The rest of the native function retains instruction differences.
